Earlier reversals were recorded by setting the original's status to 'REVERSED', which the filter already excluded.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.68, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND r.txn_id NOT IN (SELECT orig_txn_id FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL)"}}
